newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Blue-chips pull up Morocco's stock exchange.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chips pull up Morocco's stock exchange.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed on Friday higher lifted by market blue-chips, a bourse official said.
The all-share index closed at 435.65 points, up from 433.76 points last Friday.
"Generally speaking, the market reacted positively to the active trading of ONA group and its three subsidiaries," an analyst at Casablanca Finance Intermediation said.
ONA Group, Morocco's largest private conglomerate, gained nine dirhams in a week to close at 499 dirhams.
ONA has diversified stakes in more than 100 companies and a capitalisation of more than 8.3 billion dirhams.
The conglomerate's agro-industry subsidiaries, Centrale Laitiere, Lesieur, made substantial gains this week, a trader said.
Centrale Laitiere was traded at 1,625 dirhams, up from 1,545 a week earlier.
Edible oil firm Lesieur which was not traded last Friday, gained this week eight dirhams to close at 1,305 dirhams.
Traded volume on the official market was 51.8 million dirhams against 18.4 million last Friday.
